# Vacancy research: 285 12th St, Oakland

- **APN:** 002 006900301 (City records format: 002-0069-003-01; alternate: 2-69-3-1)
- **Verdict:** likely_vacant
- **Confidence:** 0.78
- **Rationale:** Likely vacant as a residence: Oakland records identify this APN as an undeveloped lot in 2016 and later as parking/storage with only a small office, not housing. In March 2026 it remained in the affordable-housing pipeline; July 2026 reporting described initial grading permits, not completed homes. No residential occupancy is evidenced since at least 2016 (over 10 years); exact start is unknown. A third-party aggregator conflicts on the address/property type.

## Vacancy start and duration

The exact date the site became nonresidential/without dwellings is not established. Oakland's June 22, 2016 planning agenda already describes this APN as an existing undeveloped lot, so the parcel had no documented dwelling by that date: at least 10 years and 3 months by the issue date (2026-10-15). This is a lower bound, not a measured continuous period of physical emptiness. City-hosted environmental records describe nonresidential parking, temporary construction storage, a vacant school yard and a small office; therefore “vacant” here means no residential occupancy, not unused land.

## Current-status limits

Oakland's March 2026 oversight packet placed the future 64-unit project in the tax-credit application pipeline. July 2, 2026 reporting described initial grading/site-preparation permit submissions and possible construction later in 2026. Neither source reports completed or occupied homes. No post-July site inspection, utility record, occupancy permit, or dated street-view observation was located, so status after July is inferred from the development timeline rather than directly observed.

A third-party aggregator assigns this APN to “285 E 12th St,” ZIP 94606, and labels it a 2-4 unit apartment house. That conflicts with the City parcel-specific location/use records for 285 12th St at 94607; it is retained as conflicting evidence, not treated as proof of occupancy.

## Sources

1. [Oakland Planning Commission agenda, June 22, 2016](https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/planning-amp-building/documents/dp/brooklyn-basin/meetings/06-22-2016-agenda.pdf) — exact APN and “existing undeveloped lot.”
2. [City-hosted environmental assessment appendix](https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/planning-amp-building/documents/dp/ceqa/2011-present/appendix_a_-appendix_f1.pdf) — parcel location/area, parking and construction storage, small office, 2017 vacant school yard.
3. [Oakland I-Bond oversight packet, March 9, 2026](https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/public-meetings/affordable-housing-amp-infrastructure-i-bond-public-oversight-committee/2026/03-09-26-i-bond-committee-meeting-agenda-packet.pdf) — project listed as having applied for tax credits in February 2026.
4. [SF YIMBY, July 2, 2026](https://sfyimby.com/2026/07/initial-grading-permits-submitted-for-285-12th-street-in-oakland.html) — grading/site-preparation permit submissions; secondary source.
5. [City of Oakland funding announcement, December 18, 2025](https://www.oaklandca.gov/News-Releases/Oakland-Awarded-35M-from-State-Climate-Action-Programs-for-Affordable-Housing-and-Transportation-Projects) — future 64-home development.
6. [CountyOffice parcel page](https://www.countyoffice.org/property-record-285-e-12th-st-oakland-ca-94606-6e9/) — conflicting address/property-type aggregator entry.

**Assessment date:** 2026-10-15. Public records support a long-standing absence of residential units; they do not establish exact vacancy onset or current site conditions after the July 2026 permit report.
